models.title: Iron Man MK7
models.author: CHANG747
models.changes: Web-optimized GLB distributed by Tilak Patel; displayed with portfolio lighting and rigid-body transforms. Mesh and textures are unchanged by this portfolio.
models.animation: No skeletal animation clips. Rigid-body motion only.
models.note: This compact model is a different asset from the user's Benjamin Borromeo high-poly reference.
models.renderingEffects: Portfolio-authored model-attached engine glow and throttle-driven exhaust; smoothed rigid-body bank and pitch. These effects do not alter the original mesh or provide skeletal animation.

models.title: Millennium Falcon
models.author: Johnson Martin
models.changes: Flightradar24's adapted glTF 1 mesh converted to glTF 2 GLB. Original geometry and normals retained with lossless meshoptimizer compression. Five diffuse gray materials converted to PBR metal/roughness materials; no texture maps in the source distribution.
models.animation: No skeletal animation clips. Rigid-body flight transforms only.
models.renderingEffects: Portfolio-authored model-attached engine glow and throttle-driven exhaust; smoothed rigid-body bank and pitch. These effects do not alter the original mesh or provide skeletal animation.
